arxiv-2004-08487.title: ∗ \ast -Autonomous Envelopes and Conservativity
arxiv-2004-08487.creator: Michael Shulman
arxiv-2004-08487.description: Abstract We prove 2-categorical conservativity for any { 𝟎 , ⊤ } \{\mathbf{0},\top\} -free fragment of MALL over its corresponding intuitionistic version: that is, that the universal map from a closed symmetric monoidal category to the ∗ \ast -autonomous category that it freely generates is fully faithful, and similarly for other doctrines.

arxiv-2011-10022.title: The Switch Point Algorithm Thanks: January 26, 2021, revised April 28, 2021. This research has been partially supported by the National Science Foundation research grants 1819002 and 2031213.
arxiv-2011-10022.creator: Mahya Aghaee, William W. Hager
arxiv-2011-10022.description: Abstract The Switch Point Algorithm is a new approach for solving optimal control problems whose solutions are either singular or bang-bang or both singular and bang-bang, and which possess a finite number of jump discontinuities in an optimal control at the points in time where the solution structure changes.

arxiv-2201-07306.title: Bregman Deviations of Generic Exponential Families
arxiv-2201-07306.creator: Sayak Ray Chowdhury, Patrick Saux, Odalric-Ambrym Maillard, Aditya Gopalan
arxiv-2201-07306.description: Abstract We revisit the method of mixtures, or Laplace method, to study the concentration phenomenon in generic (possibly multidimensional) exponential families. Using duality properties of the Bregman divergence to construct nonnegative martingales, we establish a generic inequality controlling the deviation between the parameter of the family and a finite sample estimate.

arxiv-2211-13634.title: The Belle II Upgrade Program
arxiv-2211-13634.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by *. The Belle II detector at the SuperKEKB accelerator complex is covering a wide range of exciting physics topics. To achieve the project’s research goals, a substantial increase of the data sample to 50 ab -1 is needed, and for that, the luminosity has to reach the ambitious goal of 6 × 10 35 6\times 10^{35} cm -2 s -1 .

arxiv-2402-03466.title: Physics-Encoded Graph Neural Networks for Deformation Prediction under Contact
arxiv-2402-03466.creator: Mahdi Saleh, Michael Sommersperger, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari
arxiv-2402-03466.description: Abstract In robotics, it’s crucial to understand object deformation during tactile interactions. A precise understanding of deformation can elevate robotic simulations and have broad implications across different industries. We introduce a method using Physics-Encoded Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for such predictions.

arxiv-2402-06740.title: Nearest Neighbor Complexity and Boolean Circuits
arxiv-2402-06740.creator: Mason DiCicco, Vladimir Podolskii, Daniel Reichman
arxiv-2402-06740.description: Abstract A nearest neighbor representation of a Boolean function f f is a set of vectors (anchors) labeled by 0 0 or 1 1 such that f ⁡ ( 𝒙 ) = 1 f(\boldsymbol{x})=1 if and only if the closest anchor to 𝒙 \boldsymbol{x} is labeled by 1 1 . This model was introduced by Hajnal et al.

arxiv-2406-17759.title: Interpreting Attention Layer Outputs with Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv-2406-17759.creator: Connor Kissane, Robert Krzyzanowski, Joseph Bloom, Arthur Conmy, Neel Nanda
arxiv-2406-17759.description: Abstract Decomposing model activations into interpretable components is a key open problem in mechanistic interpretability. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a popular method for decomposing the internal activations of trained transformers into sparse, interpretable features, and have been applied to MLP layers and the residual stream.

arxiv-2409-09041.title: Acceptable Use Policies for Foundation Models
arxiv-2409-09041.creator: Kevin Klyman
arxiv-2409-09041.description: Abstract As foundation models have accumulated hundreds of millions of users, developers have begun to take steps to prevent harmful types of uses. One salient intervention that foundation model developers adopt is acceptable use policies —legally binding policies that prohibit users from using a model for specific purposes.

arxiv-2503-03350.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Develop Heuristics for Emerging Optimization Problems
arxiv-2503-03350.creator: Thomas Bömer, Nico Koltermann, Max Disselnmeyer, Laura Dörr, Anne Meyer
arxiv-2503-03350.description: Abstract Combinatorial optimization problems often rely on heuristic algorithms to generate efficient solutions. However, the manual design of heuristics is resource-intensive and constrained by the designer’s expertise. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models (LLMs), have demonstrated the potential to automate heuristic generation through evolutionary frameworks.

arxiv-2505-02993.title: Very massive stars at low metallicity: evolution, synthetic spectroscopy, and impact on the integrated light of starbursts
arxiv-2505-02993.creator: F. Martins, A. Palacios, D. Schaerer, R. Marques-Chaves
arxiv-2505-02993.description: Abstract Context. Very massive stars (VMS), with a mass in excess of 100 M ☉ , are known in the Galaxy and the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC). They are mostly characterised by their strong stellar winds compared to normal massive stars. Their mass loss rates have been calibrated at the metallicity of the LMC. No constraint exist at other metallicities.

arxiv-2509-09040.description: Abstract Dated: August 10, 2026 Abstract The generation of dense electron-positron pair beams in the laboratory can enable direct tests of theoretical models of \gamma -ray bursts and active galactic nuclei. We have successfully achieved this using ultra-relativistic protons accelerated by the Super Proton Synchrotron at CERN.

pmc-10595330.creator: M Wymann
pmc-10595330.description: Issue/problemLegionnaires’ disease numbers have been increasing in Switzerland since 2001. The reported cases are mainly severe, about 87 % are diagnosed by hospitals, about 5 % have already died at the time of reporting.

pmc-11453356.description: Disclosure: A. Arunachalam: None. P. Iyer: None.Struma ovarii is a monodermal teratoma primarily composed of mature thyroid tissue.[1] Depending on histologic findings, struma ovarii can be classified as benign or malignant. Among malignant struma ovarii, papillary type is the most common.2Women with struma ovarii can present with pelvic pain and less frequently ascites. Clinical features of hyperthyroidism can occur.

Health care systems, specifically operating rooms (ORs), are significant contributors to greenhouse gas emissions, using 3 to 6 times more energy than the hospital’s average unit.

pmc-11667292.title: Effect of Fluorine Atoms and Piperazine Rings on Biotoxicity of Norfloxacin Analogues: Combined Experimental and Theoretical Study
pmc-11667292.creator: Chuanxi Yang, Xiaoning Wang, Xinyan Zhao, Yongkun Wu, Jingyan Lin, Yuhan Zhao, Yiyong Xu, Kaipeng Sun, Chao Zhang, Ziheng Wan, Weihua Zhao, Yihua Xiao, Haofen Sun, Dong Chen, Wenping Dong, Tieyu Wang, Weiliang Wang
pmc-11667292.description: To clarify the effect of the fluorine atom and piperazine ring on norfloxacin (NOR), NOR degradation products (NOR-DPs, P1–P8) were generated via UV combined with hydrogen peroxide (UV/H2O2) technology. NOR degradation did not significantly affect cytotoxicity of NOR against BV2, A549, HepG2, and Vero E6 cells.

pmc-11691785.title: ADVERSE CHILDHOOD EXPERIENCES AND SLEEP DEPRIVATION IN OLDER ADULTS: THE MEDIATING ROLE OF SOCIAL ISOLATION
pmc-11691785.creator: Syeda Jesmin, Iftekhar Amin
pmc-11691785.description: BackgroundBetween 40% and 70% of older adults have chronic sleep issues that can negatively affect their physical and mental health. While research shows that exposure to adverse childhood Experiences (ACEs) can be related to later life sleep quality, it is not clear how social isolation in later life can mediate this relationship.

pmc-12831944.title: Comparison of Improvements in Quality of Life With Disease-Modifying Anti-rheumatic Drugs in Seropositive and Seronegative Rheumatoid Arthritis
pmc-12831944.creator: Avinash Muraleedharan, Shweta Chaubey, Shalu A, Ashish Yadav
pmc-12831944.description: Background: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic, progressive autoimmune disorder characterized by joint pain, stiffness, and deformities, leading to functional impairment and reduced quality of life (QoL). Disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs) are the cornerstone of therapy, effectively reducing disease activity and improving health-related QoL (HRQoL).

pmc-12844214.title: Impact of Magnetohydrodynamics on Thermal Mixing Efficiency and Entropy Generation Analysis Passing Through a Micromixer Using Non-Newtonian Nanofluid
pmc-12844214.creator: Naas Toufik Tayeb, Youcef Abdellah Ayoub Laouid, Ayache Lakhdar, Telha Mostefa, Sun Min Kim, Shakhawat Hossain
pmc-12844214.description: The present paper investigates the steady laminar flow and thermal mixing performance of non-Newtonian Al2O3 nanofluids within a two-layer cross-channel micromixer, employing three-dimensional numerical simulations to solve the governing equations across a low Reynolds number range (0.1 to 50). It also addresses secondary flows and thermal mixing performance with two distinct inlet temperatures for thin nanofluids.

pmc-13213161.title: Revolutionizing Nursing Education in Somalia: Recommendations for Integrating AI and Deep Learning in Outcome Based Assessments to Enhance Knowledge, Practice, and Graduate Competence
pmc-13213161.creator: Fathi Yasin Yusuf, Abdiwali Mohamed Hussein
pmc-13213161.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning hold significant potential to strengthen outcome-based assessment in Somali nursing education. Somalia’s nursing education system faces critical challenges including inadequate standardization, uneven competency assessment, urban–rural disparities in access, limited faculty capacity, and weak governance.

pmc-13231697.title: Spontaneous resolution of vitreomacular traction following deep scuba diving: a case report
pmc-13231697.creator: Iden Amiri, Aya Barzelay-Wollman
pmc-13231697.description: BackgroundVitreomacular traction is characterized by incomplete posterior vitreous detachment, wherein persistent adherence of the vitreous to the macula results in tractional distortion and associated visual symptoms. Although spontaneous resolution of vitreomacular traction may occur, surgical intervention is typically pursued when significant visual impairment occurs.

pmc-13374352.title: Knowledge and perceptions of climate change and diarrhea prevention practices in Nepal
pmc-13374352.creator: Bimala Dhimal, Rijan Bhakta Kayastha, Biraj Man Karmacharya
pmc-13374352.description: BackgroundDespite growing awareness of the health risks associated with climate change, how Nepalese people perceive these threats and their links to diarrheal diseases remains insufficiently understood in Nepal. This study examines and compares knowledge of climate change and diarrheal prevention practices among communities in four districts in Koshi and Karnali provinces.
